root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before flb_utils_write_str() may call encoded_to_buf(p, tmp, len) for the high-byte `\u%04x` escape, the remaining bytes in the caller-provided JSON slice (`available - written`) must be at least len. Otherwise the helper must return FLB_FALSE so the caller can reallocate and retry.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable helper only enforces a fixed 6-byte threshold before formatting the escape, so a call with six bytes left can still reach the copy site even when snprintf(...) already produced a longer escape string.

nodes.state: At the unconditional terminator store, `off` is already at or beyond `json_size`, so `json_str[off]` writes outside the JSON buffer.
At the high-byte UTF-8 escape copy, `encoded_to_buf(p, tmp, len)` is about to copy more bytes than remain in the caller-provided JSON slice.

edges.relation: The same escape length computed by `snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp) - 1, "\u%04x", codepoint)` at the missing root check is passed unchanged as the `len` argument to `encoded_to_buf(...)`.
The caller offset implied by the overflowing escape copy is the same `off` later used by `flb_msgpack_to_json()` for the unconditional terminator store.
